
use Core

global = 100

enum Value
{
    A       // 0
    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    B = 5   // 5
    C       // 6
    D       // 7
}

define sum(a int, b int)
{
    return a + b
}

class Name {

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}

    define someMath(a int, b string)
    {
        a = () => 3
        b = a() // 3

        x = 10
        y = 20

        for z, index in array
        {
            x = z.length()
            y = x * 10
            y = "Test"  // Error
        }

        return x, y
    }

}
